dataset_boundary.note: this artifact covers GDN/linear-attention operators only; it does not price attention, MoE or the rest of the layer

kv_invariance.async_scope: whole GDN layer stack (conv + recurrent scan + gating), not this operator alone; the per-operator rows are the isolated medians
kv_invariance.criterion: every KV-length median within 6% of the arm median, arm spread <= 10%, and the device-side async incremental cost not growing >15% from KV 32k to KV 126976 (a fall is overlap, not a penalty)
kv_invariance.note: kv_stream here ends each KV read with .item(), so its delta over kv_resident is a constant host-launch effect (15-18 us at every KV length), not a KV-byte term; kv_async_* removes the host sync and is the device-side decision number

linear_conv/npu_causal_conv1d_update.model_form: ms = per_geometry_batch_median (KV-length invariant: the operator reads only its constant state and the measured cost does not grow with KV 32k/64k/126976)
linear_conv/npu_causal_conv1d_update.work_unit_description: KV working-set bytes held/streamed at decode

recurrent_scan/npu_recurrent_gated_delta.declared_scope_note: declared_median_ms is the operator alone (q/k pre-normalised outside the timed region); add l2norm_scope.l2norm_inclusive_ms for the layer's full scan pre-op+op cost

kv_invariance.async_scope: whole GDN layer stack (conv + recurrent scan + gating), not this operator alone; the per-operator rows are the isolated medians
kv_invariance.criterion: every KV-length median within 6% of the arm median, arm spread <= 10%, and the device-side async incremental cost not growing >15% from KV 32k to KV 126976 (a fall is overlap, not a penalty)
kv_invariance.note: kv_stream here ends each KV read with .item(), so its delta over kv_resident is a constant host-launch effect (15-18 us at every KV length), not a KV-byte term; kv_async_* removes the host sync and is the device-side decision number

l2norm_scope.scope: operator-only medians are the declared scan_decode row; the served layer also pays l2norm_fwd on q/k before the operator (the 32k artifact's 0.2848 ms/layer row included it inside the timed lambda)

recurrent_scan/npu_recurrent_gated_delta.model_form: ms = per_geometry_batch_median (KV-length invariant: the operator reads only its constant state and the measured cost does not grow with KV 32k/64k/126976)
recurrent_scan/npu_recurrent_gated_delta.work_unit_description: KV working-set bytes held/streamed at decode

fit_bands.method: per-role least squares on the deployed work unit; form chosen by leave-one-out WAPE; the band is the max absolute percentage residual over all measured conditions; held-out numbers refit without the scored length

machine.aicore_clock_source: rated 1650 MHz for Ascend950DT 9582; npu-smi -t clock not exposed on 25.1.rc3.1; torch_npu.npu.clock_rate absent
machine.urma_noise_policy: no URMA leg in this single-die job; dmesg has no urma records; -110 accepted-noise rule applied but nothing to accept

provenance.canary_rule: a role is admitted only when its operator output reproduces a CPU fp32 reference of the same math at small shapes (conv 64 tokens, conv update 4 slots, gating 257x48, recurrent scan 4 steps, chunk scan one 64-token chunk)
provenance.container_cleanup: hp-op-gdnlc removed after the run; dies 0-7 checked free before and after
provenance.contention_note: A foreign HCCL reduce_test (8 processes, launched from rack06os1) occupied all rack06os2 dies 20:19:44-20:24 and overlapped the first stream attempt, which was discarded. The 33 s main matrix finished 20:18:47, before it; the clean stream/async/fill runs are after it exited. Separately, the chunked scan at b4 x 126976 requests a 35.33 GiB internal workspace (measured: NPU out of memory, 22.59 GiB live, 28.73 GiB free); the refusal left the device context in error state (507035 vector-core on the next synchronize), so that amortised block and the qwen3.5 post-prefill cells were re-measured in a fresh process (stream_fill.json).
provenance.sample_reduction: no condition exceeded 1000 ms/sample; every row kept 2x20 device events

async_kv_pressure.scope: whole GDN layer stack (conv update + recurrent scan + gating) with the KV read enqueued asynchronously ahead of each layer, no host sync inside the timed block
